decision: When a sheet's onDismiss runs, restore focus to the current eligible opener of the presentation that actually ended, ignoring the dismissal of a sheet that a newer presentation replaced.

evidence.note: No Haiku observation in this cell. Gemini 3.8 Flash low and Gemini 4 Argon high failed 3 of 4 (1 inconclusive); reviewer mechanism: the real sheet callback captured a mutable current presentation ID by lookup at completion. The package fixture drops the presentation-generation check.

variants.why: Keeps a FIFO of presented requests; each onDismiss retires the oldest and only the last one restores.
Inventory mechanism: the callback reads a mutable current origin at completion, so the swapped-out sheet's late dismissal moves focus behind the copy's editor.
Looks up the sheet item at completion; SwiftUI already cleared it, so every close falls back to Add Bookmark.
Decides the destination when the editor opens, so a bookmark deleted by sync is still targeted.
Treats every onDismiss as the end of editing and clears the copy's editor.
